name: a deletion claimed before Attest first looked at the calendar is never NOT_FOUND: the change was not followed
notes: §6.1 v1.11: a calendar.updated or calendar.deleted claim counts no gcal.event entry towards full coverage: every entry overlapping its window is capped, coverage.change_unprovable. Calendar is read as snapshots, so a change made between two looks and then moved, changed again or removed leaves nothing to compare, and no view can say a change was never made. (v1.9 and v1.10 capped only an entry that had not followed changes over the change span [start(p,t) − beforeClaimMin, end(p,t) + graceMin], with coverage.changes_unfollowed; this file's two entries were both such entries, so its grade is unchanged and only the cap's code changed.)
c1: muse says at 14:02 (minute) that it deleted 'Board dinner' (targetAt 10-08 19:00). Window [10-05 19:00, 10-11 19:00] (± calendarDays 3). Change span [14:00, 14:33].

Coverage (acct-a, every calendar, bound by the grant, week [10-05 00:00, 10-12 00:00] ⊇ the window): Attest first looked at 14:10 (no changesSince) and compared again at 14:50 (changesSince 14:10). The event was already gone at 14:10, so no pass could see it deleted. Both entries are capped (change_unprovable), as every entry of a change claim is.

o1 'Dentist' (10-07 09:00) is what the first look found (calendar.created, first seen 14:10): not of c1's type, so no candidate; a first-look row, so no orphan (§3 v1.9). c1 has no candidate → match.none, score null.

Rules: no_target no (targetAt set); underspecified no (subjectOverlap applies); no_coverage no (two entries overlap the window: partial); verified, partial no (no candidate); pending no: graceElapsed needs an entry synced ≥ end + graceMin = 14:33, and the 14:50 entry is (a capped entry still proves the sync); partial_coverage: coverage partial and bestScoreLt partial (no candidate) → UNVERIFIABLE.

Reasons: coverage.partial {source: gcal.event}, the cap coverage.change_unprovable {source: gcal.event}, match.none. PENDING (§8): partial_coverage finalises only at end + finalizeUnverifiableHours = 10-07 14:03.
Under v1.8 the same entries were full coverage (every calendar, the account bound) and c1 was NOT_FOUND, FINAL: a false NOT_FOUND for a deletion that happened before Attest looked (Hard Rule 5).
